layers.authority: Torres Strait Island Regional Council (each island's Divisional office and elected Councillor)
layers.process: Permission is needed to visit the outer islands (other than Thursday and Horn islands). Submit the council's visitor registration (community entry) form before arriving; some communities also ask visitors to sign a visitor book. Travelling to a community without permission may be an offence.

sources.title: Community profiles
sources.supports: contact the island's council office in advance

zone-requirements.note: The lead time is a planning buffer. Treaty traditional visitors from PNG follow DFAT's Torres Strait Treaty guidelines.
